# awscc_chime_sip_media_application (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Chime::SipMediaApplication



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aws_region` (String) The AWS Region in which the SIP media application is created.
- `endpoints` (Attributes List) List of endpoints (Lambda ARNs) specified for the SIP media application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `name` (String) The name of the SIP media application.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags assigned to the SIP media application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_timestamp` (String) The SIP media application creation timestamp, in ISO 8601 format.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `sip_media_application_arn` (String) The ARN of the SIP media application.
- `sip_media_application_id` (String) The SIP media application ID.
- `updated_timestamp` (String) The time at which the SIP media application was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Required:

- `lambda_arn` (String) Valid Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Lambda function.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_chime_sip_media_application.example
  identity = {
    sip_media_application_arn = "sip_media_application_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `sip_media_application_arn` (String) The ARN of the SIP media application

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_chime_sip_media_application.example
  id = "sip_media_application_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
